name: ibis Pattaya
short_description: A 254-room budget hotel on Pattaya Second Road with a 4.4/5 ALL rating from over 1,000 reviews.
ai_summary: ibis Pattaya sits on Pattaya Second Road, close to the city's nightlife, street food, and shopping. The hotel's own Accor listing shows a 4.4/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,027 reviews, and describes 254 rooms with Wi-Fi throughout, an outdoor pool, and a bar and restaurant. It is part of Accor's MyResorts programme for ALL members.

core_facts.address: 463/79 Moo 9, Pattaya Second Road, Nhongprue Banglamung, 20150 Pattaya, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per ALL - Accor Live Limitless programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 254 rooms with Wi-Fi throughout at a budget price point
4.4/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,027 reviews
Central Pattaya Second Road location near nightlife, street food, and shopping
Outdoor swimming pool and on-site bar/restaurant
cons: Budget-tier hotel without the resort facilities of Pattaya's beachfront properties
Pattaya Second Road location is set back from the beach itself
research_highlights: Accor's own hotel page confirms 254 rooms and a 4.4/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,027 reviews
Highlights nearby attractions including Pattaya Beach, Terminal 21 Pattaya, and the Tiffany cabaret show
research_watchouts: Facts sourced from the hotel's own Accor listing page; no independent dated review or video was found to cross-check against

faqs.question: Is ibis Pattaya on the beach?
faqs.answer: No -- it's on Pattaya Second Road, set back from the beachfront but within easy reach of Pattaya's nightlife, street food, and shopping. The 254-room budget hotel carries a 4.4/5 ALL guest rating from roughly 1,027 reviews, with an outdoor pool and on-site bar and restaurant for guests who don't need direct beach access.

source_mix.label: Official ibis Pattaya page on ALL - Accor Live Limitless
